definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.report_checkin_entries(p_show_id uuid, p_include_scratched boolean DEFAULT false, p_section_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(entry_id uuid, show_id uuid, section_id uuid, exhibitor_id uuid, exhibitor_label text, exhibitor_showing_name text, exhibitor_display_name text, exhibitor_first_name text, exhibitor_last_name text, exhibitor_arba_number text, exhibitor_address_line1 text, exhibitor_address_line2 text, exhibitor_city text, exhibitor_state text, exhibitor_zip text, exhibitor_phone text, exhibitor_email text, section_letter text, section_display_name text, section_kind text, section_sort_order integer, species text, breed text, group_name text, group_sort_order integer, variety text, variety_sort_order integer, sex text, class_name text, class_age_label text, class_sort_order integer, tattoo text, scratched_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, entry_fee_cents numeric, balance_due_all_shows numeric, balance_due_this_show numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
with base as (
  select
    r.*,
    round(coalesce(fs.fee_per_entry, 0) * 100)::numeric as entry_fee_cents
  from public.report_entry_base_v r
  left join public.show_section_fee_settings fs
    on fs.section_id = r.section_id
  where r.show_id = p_show_id
    and (p_include_scratched = true or r.scratched_at is null)
    and (p_section_id is null or r.section_id = p_section_id)
),

-- Source of truth for exhibitor balances.
-- This applies the same discount/payment logic used by the Unpaid Exhibitor Balances report.
show_balances as (
  select
    rsb.exhibitor_id,
    rsb.balance_due_cents,
    rsb.calculated_total_cents,
    rsb.discount_cents,
    rsb.paid_online_cents,
    rsb.paid_manual_cents,
    rsb.refunded_cents
  from public.report_show_exhibitor_balances(p_show_id) rsb
)

select
  b.entry_id,
  b.show_id,
  b.section_id,
  b.exhibitor_id,
  b.exhibitor_label,
  b.exhibitor_showing_name,
  b.exhibitor_display_name,
  b.exhibitor_first_name,
  b.exhibitor_last_name,
  b.exhibitor_arba_number,
  b.exhibitor_address_line1,
  b.exhibitor_address_line2,
  b.exhibitor_city,
  b.exhibitor_state,
  b.exhibitor_zip,
  b.exhibitor_phone,
  b.exhibitor_email,
  b.section_letter,
  b.section_display_name,
  b.section_kind::text,
  b.section_sort_order,
  b.species,
  b.breed,
  b.group_name,
  b.group_sort_order,
  b.variety,
  b.variety_sort_order,
  b.sex,
  b.class_name,
  b.class_age_label,
  b.class_sort_order,
  b.tattoo,
  b.scratched_at,
  b.created_at,
  b.entry_fee_cents,

  -- The check-in sheet should show the same balance due as the Unpaid Exhibitor Balances report.
  (coalesce(sb.balance_due_cents, 0)::numeric / 100.0)
    as balance_due_all_shows,

  -- Keep this populated for older Flutter code paths.
  -- For combined/all-section check-in sheets, this intentionally matches all-show balance.
  (coalesce(sb.balance_due_cents, 0)::numeric / 100.0)
    as balance_due_this_show

from base b
left join show_balances sb
  on sb.exhibitor_id = b.exhibitor_id
order by
  lower(coalesce(b.exhibitor_label, '')),
  case
    when lower(coalesce(b.section_kind::text, '')) = 'open' then 1
    when lower(coalesce(b.section_kind::text, '')) = 'youth' then 2
    else 99
  end,
  coalesce(b.section_sort_order, 9999),
  coalesce(b.section_letter, ''),
  lower(coalesce(b.breed, '')),
  coalesce(b.group_sort_order, 9999),
  lower(coalesce(b.group_name, '')),
  coalesce(b.variety_sort_order, 9999),
  lower(coalesce(b.variety, '')),
  coalesce(b.class_sort_order, 9999),
  lower(coalesce(b.tattoo, ''));
$function$

arguments: p_show_id uuid, p_section_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_include_scratched boolean DEFAULT false
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.report_control_sheet_entries(p_show_id uuid, p_section_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_include_scratched boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(entry_id uuid, show_id uuid, section_id uuid, exhibitor_id uuid, exhibitor_label text, section_letter text, section_display_name text, section_kind text, section_sort_order integer, species text, breed text, uses_variety_awards boolean, uses_group_awards boolean, group_id uuid, group_name text, group_sort_order integer, variety text, variety_sort_order integer, sex text, sex_sort_order integer, class_name text, class_age_label text, class_sort_order integer, animal_name text, tattoo text, is_fur boolean, is_wool boolean, scratched_at timestamp with time zone, judged_by_show_judge_id uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select distinct on (r.entry_id)
    r.entry_id,
    r.show_id,
    r.section_id,
    r.exhibitor_id,
    r.exhibitor_label,
    r.section_letter,
    r.section_display_name,
    r.section_kind::text,
    r.section_sort_order,
    r.species,
    r.breed,
    r.uses_variety_awards,
    r.uses_group_awards,
    r.group_id,
    r.group_name,
    r.group_sort_order,
    r.variety,
    r.variety_sort_order,
    r.sex,
    r.sex_sort_order,
    r.class_name,
    r.class_age_label,
    r.class_sort_order,
    r.animal_name,
    r.tattoo,
    coalesce(e.is_fur, false) as is_fur,
    false as is_wool,
    r.scratched_at,
    r.judged_by_show_judge_id,
    r.created_at
  from public.report_entry_base_v r
  join public.entries e
    on e.id = r.entry_id
  where r.show_id = p_show_id
    and (p_include_scratched = true or r.scratched_at is null)
    and (p_section_id is null or r.section_id = p_section_id)
  order by
    r.entry_id,
    case
      when lower(coalesce(r.section_kind::text, '')) = 'open' then 1
      when lower(coalesce(r.section_kind::text, '')) = 'youth' then 2
      else 99
    end,
    coalesce(r.section_sort_order, 9999),
    coalesce(r.section_letter, ''),
    lower(coalesce(r.breed, '')),
    coalesce(r.group_sort_order, 9999),
    lower(coalesce(r.group_name, '')),
    coalesce(r.variety_sort_order, 9999),
    lower(coalesce(r.variety, '')),
    coalesce(r.class_sort_order, 9999),
    coalesce(r.sex_sort_order, 9999),
    lower(coalesce(r.tattoo, ''));
$function$
